posts.name: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2
posts.tagline: Turns website traffic into booked, qualified meetings
posts.description: Your book-a-demo button converts 1-2% of visitors. The rest leave. Naoma replaces the form with an AI account executive that runs the demo right then: it walks the prospect through your live product, answers questions, qualifies them and books the meeting. It remembers returning visitors, picks up where they left off, and writes every session back to your CRM. 50,000+ demos run for B2B SaaS teams. Now self-serve: upload your product and knowledge base test the agent today.

posts.name: Web Search Agents by Nimble
posts.tagline: Self-learning agents automate web research + retrieval
posts.description: Web Search Agents are expert web crawling and research agents for your specific domain (company enrichment, regulations research, etc.). They self-learn your use case to go deeper into the sources that matter most to you, giving your AI deeper and more relevant web context. To get started, give your AI this link: https://docs.nimbleway.com/agent-onboarding.md

posts.name: Hello Inbox
posts.tagline: Get more marketing emails into the inbox
posts.description: Hello Inbox helps marketing teams get more emails into the inbox instead of spam. Test your campaigns before you send, see what is hurting deliverability, and get clear recommendations for what to fix. Instead of throwing deliverability scores and technical data at you, Hello Inbox turns the results into actionable steps so you can improve inbox placement without becoming an email deliverability expert.

posts.name: Slashy Assistant
posts.tagline: The AI assistant that does email for you
posts.description: Slashy is an AI-native email client for managing all your inboxes. Slashy Assistant is the AI built into it: it drafts replies in your voice, organizes email, schedules meetings, prepares briefings, and tracks follow-ups. Connect your calendar, CRM, meeting notes, and favorite tools, and it starts helping within five minutes. Use it inside Slashy or through iMessage, Slack, or a phone call. Set up automations in plain English, and Slashy proactively handles recurring work before you have to ask.

posts.name: Oats
posts.tagline: Free, open-source, and on device meeting notetaker
posts.description: Oats is an AI meeting note-taking tool that is completely open, local, and free. Designed to not get in the way of your meetings, no bots, no subscription needed when running locally with on-device LLM. Available on both macOS and Windows. Enhanced transcription, multi-language support, speaker recognition, assessment, coaching, auto-tracking follow ups and more features via ariso.ai cloud backend.

posts.name: Elva
posts.tagline: Goodbye, Postman. Your APIs have new consumers
posts.description: Developers use your APIs. Now agents do too. Elva discovers APIs from code, lets you choose what each audience can use, and runs your MCP servers with auth and analytics. Track agent activity and review changes as your code evolves

posts.name: Aside
posts.tagline: AI browser that actually gets work done for you
posts.description: Aside is a browser rebuilt for people and agents. It signs into your accounts, uses websites directly, and finishes complex work: messages, payments, internal tools, even local files. - Crafted in every detail: vertical tabs and Liquid Glass. - SOTA on agentic browsing benchmarks: outperforms Claude Cowork. - Full privacy: everything runs locally and is encrypted. - You can use your Claude or ChatGPT subscription.

posts.name: LLMagnet
posts.tagline: Make your WordPress site visible to AI
posts.description: LLMagnet gives WordPress sites an AI visibility layer. Track visits from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI crawlers, measure your AI Visibility Score, generate llms.txt and structured data, and make your site readable and actionable for AI agents.

posts.name: AppZapper 3000
posts.tagline: The uninstaller Apple forgot.
posts.description: The most fun uninstaller for macOS has been rebuilt for the 31st century. Introducing AppZapper 3000. Drag in any app and instantly find all of its extra files. Then delete them with a real 3D zapper.

posts.name: OzBrain
posts.tagline: Your knowledge shared with every AI agent & any teammate
posts.description: Your Dropbox for agent knowledge (it works without you having to "work" it or maintain it.) Every agent you use reads and writes to the same brain, and so do your teammates and theirs. Start a new chat and it can know what you've all already worked on. Your IP, research, sci-fi romance novel or notes are encrypted and I won't train on it. Export it to markdown and leave whenever, because I think you shouldn't have your knowledge locked in anywhere, including OzBrain.

posts.name: appdesigns
posts.tagline: Design amazing appstore screenshots for free
posts.description: appdesigns is a free, in-browser editor for App Store and Google Play screenshots. Drop in your screens, frame them in the latest iPhone, iPad or Mac, add headlines, backgrounds and stickers, and export at the exact sizes App Store Connect asks for. Design the whole set side by side, tilt and scale devices, or start from a community template. Unlimited exports, no watermark, and no account needed to start.

posts.name: TryCase
posts.tagline: AI tests your PRs. Get a video walkthrough before you merge.
posts.description: Open a PR. TryCase uses your app like a real user and sends back a video walkthrough of your changes, plus a test verdict, right on GitHub. See what happened before you merge, with multiple PRs tested in parallel.

posts.name: Image to ASCII
posts.tagline: Make ASCII art for READMEs, Discord & creative visuals
posts.description: Give your README a signature, your Discord a mascot, or your next blog post a character-art cover. Turn photos and logos into ASCII locally in your browser—free, with no signup or image upload. Start with a built-in example, compare before/after, and tune presets, detail and color. Copy text or Markdown; export TXT, PNG, SVG, HTML or ANSI. Text formats keep editable characters; image exports preserve the look. Try the neon jellyfish or make an 80-column fox README mark.

posts.name: Deplo
posts.tagline: A simple-to-use alternative to cloud deployments
posts.description: Same push-to-deploy you already know, running on a machine you already pay for. No Docker. No SSH. No invoice.

posts.name: Juggler
posts.tagline: A visual AI coding harness
posts.description: Juggler is a desktop workbench for AI coding agents. Tool calls, approvals, thread structure and raw context are laid out in Finder-style columns. Conversations branch into sub-threads. Every tool is a JavaScript plugin. Free, open-source, one Go binary.

posts.name: Afterglow
posts.tagline: Run classic After Dark screen savers on modern macOS
posts.description: Afterglow runs classic After Dark screen saver modules — Flying Toasters, Fish!, Starry Skyline, and more — natively on macOS, with no ROMs required.

posts.name: MemoryPet 2.0
posts.tagline: Turn your browsers toolbar into an animated usage monitor
posts.description: MemoryPet puts a tiny animated pet in your Chrome toolbar that speeds up or slows down based on your system's memory or CPU usage, a glanceable, oddly satisfying read on how hard your machine is working. 2.0 adds CPU tracking alongside memory, 8 new pets, a hover-able usage graph, and a way to turn the animation off entirely and just watch a live percentage badge instead.

posts.name: Marqly 6.0
posts.tagline: Ask your bookmarks. Bring them to your AI.
posts.description: Your bookmarks have more to give. Marqly 6.0 adds an AI Assistant that answers from your saves, an AI Organizer that proposes a cleaner library for you to review, and MCP to bring your saved research into Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor. Keep articles, highlights, videos, and AI chats together. Available on the web, in your browser, and on iOS. Android is coming very soon. AI features are included in Pro.

posts.name: OVO
posts.tagline: Play music from files, iCloud & streams across Apple devices
posts.description: OVO is a premium music player for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Bring local files, Apple Music, supported SoundCloud content, live streams, and synced folders into one focused library. Listen offline, shape playback with a 10-band EQ, and privately sync your library between iPhone and iPad through iCloud.

posts.name: Bluey Email - AI Email Marketing
posts.tagline: Flat Pricing and AI Native Email Marketing
posts.description: Bluey bills for emails sent, not contacts stored, so your bill doesn't step up the day you cross 25K contacts. Marketing campaigns, transactional sends like receipts and OTPs, and a CRM with a deal pipeline live in one account on one bill instead of three vendors. Composer writes a whole campaign from one sentence. Grow plan is $30/mo for 50K sends with unlimited contacts.

posts.name: Sequenzy: AI-Native Email Marketing Tool
posts.tagline: Powerful Email Marketing Tool for SaaS
posts.description: Sequenzy turns a prompt into on-brand emails and complete automations, including copy, design, delays, and conditions. Connect Stripe and PostHog to target users by subscription status, revenue, and product activity. Create onboarding, payment recovery, and win-back sequences with AI, then review and edit before activating. Built for SaaS founders who want better emails without building every step by hand.

posts.name: Outclimbed
posts.tagline: Rank #1 without a $20,000 budget
posts.description: Outclimbed is a public product directory where the ranking is not a secret. $10 puts your site or X profile on the wall with 10 permanent points, and every extra dollar is one more point. Every new person you send through your share link is +1, and +5 if they list a product of their own. Earned points expire after 30 days, so the wall keeps moving. Each listing shows what it paid and what it earned. No editorial picks, no hidden weighting, no five-figure barrier to the top.

posts.name: Snout
posts.tagline: Track Every Dose. Never Miss a Visit.
posts.description: Snout keeps your pet's whole health picture in one place: medications, vet visits, food, vaccines, weight, and daily routines, with a Today view showing what's due and when. Native for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Share with family so everyone stays in sync. Free for one pet. Snout+ (one-time purchase, subscription optional) unlocks unlimited pets, PDF export, backups, widgets, Apple Calendar sync, and sharing. Works fully offline, syncing privately through your own iCloud — no account, no ads.

posts.name: Flalingo AI Speaking Coach
posts.tagline: Speak from day one with real-time AI voice practice
posts.description: Flalingo turns the language you understand into speaking practice. Take a two-minute spoken level check, then practise in short real-time voice conversations with an AI coach. Each session returns explained corrections, pronunciation feedback and review exercises built from your mistakes. Daily missions and a personal learning path keep the next step clear across English and 12 other languages. Available on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Sparkian
posts.tagline: AI chat, compare & create with 70+ AI models
posts.description: Sparkian brings Claude, GPT, Gemini, and 70+ other models into one workspace. Run the same prompt across models side-by-side, generate images, research with cited sources, and collaborate with your team in shared Projects all under one subscription.

posts.name: Netra Runtime
posts.tagline: Fastest AI Inference at Any Scale
posts.description: Run production AI with lower latency and higher throughput. Use Netra Cloud's OpenAI-compatible API or deploy Netra Runtime on your own GPU infrastructure.

posts.name: Premove ITN
posts.tagline: Open-source context-aware ITN for voice agents
posts.description: Premove ITN is an open-source, context-aware inverse text normalizer built for voice agents. It turns messy ASR transcripts into structured values APIs can actually use: phone numbers, dates, times, amounts, IDs, emails, URLs, and more. Instead of generating normalized text directly, it deterministically produces valid candidates, uses a neural model to score them in sentence context, and applies exact decoding to choose compatible outputs. Open weights, Python package, real-time inference.

posts.name: Koffeelab: Your coffee journal
posts.tagline: For the ones who already count the grams.
posts.description: Track every brew, dial in your recipe, and see a map of everywhere you have made a great cup. Your whole coffee history, in one place. Get detailed insights into what type of coffee you like the most, while never forgetting your best brews. Do this while sharing your journey with friends

posts.name: Syncline
posts.tagline: Every layer of your stack, folded onto one timeline.
posts.description: Syncline replays a user session as video and the backend distributed trace and the SQL queries that ran - on one synchronized scrubber.

posts.name: Ottermind
posts.tagline: Turn goals and files into polished, editable deliverables.
posts.description: Stop Getting Answers. Start Shipping Real the file in this message. Ottermind turns your goals, prompts, and files into polished, editable presentations, reports, spreadsheets, images, videos, websites, and more. One workspace, multiple AI models, no coding or agent setup required.

posts.name: Landing page inspiration
posts.tagline: Landing page inspiration, filtered down to the section
posts.description: 359 hand-picked landing pages, portfolios and SaaS sites. Filter by style, colour, tech or interaction — or jump straight to the section you need: hero, pricing, FAQ, footer. Every site shows its fonts and colour palette, ready to copy. Free to browse.

posts.name: tersOS
posts.tagline: The coworking operating system, built by operators
posts.description: tersOS runs a coworking space from one system: room and desk bookings, memberships and invoicing, a member app for iOS, Android and the web, community feed and chat, a live floor plan, screens on the walls, events, a shared inbox and CRM, newsletters, and tersAI, an assistant that answers questions and books rooms for staff, members and visitors. It is built by the team that runs tershouse, a coworking space in Sarajevo, and runs that space every day.

posts.name: LeadSnipper
posts.tagline: Cold email infrastructure built for safer outbound.
posts.description: LeadSnipper is a cold email platform built around owning your sending infrastructure. Connect Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and SMTP then manage sequences, lead verification, inbox rotation, sending limits, deliverability protection, reply detection, and analytics from one dashboard. Instead of separate tools for verification, sending, and deliverability, LeadSnipper brings the workflow together — with Reoon verification and auto-pause guardrails designed to protect your sender reputation.

posts.name: ShopPilot
posts.tagline: Your AI ecommerce consultant, working across all your tools
posts.description: ShopPilot is an AI ecommerce consultant that works inside the tools you already pay for. It learns your business, finds growth opportunities and completes expert work across Shopify, Klaviyo, Yotpo, Meta, Google Ads and more. Three times a week, ShopPilot emails you with the work it has completed. Campaigns, flows and account changes are ready for your review. Your only job is to press launch. Free for two weeks, then $499 a month.

posts.name: Plugin Auditor
posts.tagline: Know what's in WordPress plugin before it touches your site
posts.description: Run 125 automated checks on any WordPress plugin before it touches your site. Catch SQL injection, XSS, deprecated functions, and more. Free, no account needed.

posts.name: Suvo
posts.tagline: Scan. Track. Understand your supplements stack
posts.description: Suvo is a supplement tracker for scanning your stack, spotting interactions, and timing doses around meals and sleep. Build a clearer supplement schedule.

posts.name: kadence
posts.tagline: Git-native task journal your team and AI agents both read
posts.description: Tasks, their whole history and the time they took live in your git repo as an append-only journal: one JSON file per event, never edited, never deleted. Everyone else keeps state — a task file, a row, a spec. State drifts, conflicts on merge and forgets. Events cannot: board and velocity are folded from the journal on read. Your team reads it in the terminal, your AI agents read the same thing as --json. No server, no account, no network. MIT.

posts.name: SpeechOn
posts.tagline: Free 5-minute speech warm-ups in your browser - no sign-up
posts.description: A free speech warm-up in your browser, before your next meeting - no sign-up. Pick 5, 8, 12 minutes, or Heavy (~20 minutes): breath setup, jaw and lip relaxation, lip trills, exaggerated articulation, pause placement, everyday speaking. 1,700+ people across 24 countries tried it within days. SpeechOn is a practice tool, not a treatment or therapy; the routines are not clinically validated and it doesn't assess speech or replace speech therapy. Free forever.

posts.name: OneTask
posts.tagline: Fast, single purpose tools. Nothing leaves your browser.
posts.description: A growing collection of fast, free, single-purpose tools. No sign-up, no upload — everything runs in your browser.

posts.name: W.A.S.P.
posts.tagline: Undetectable Open-Source Mouse Jiggler & Activity Simulator
posts.description: WASP - Free, open-source mouse jiggler and activity simulator. The ultimate work activity simulator designed to bypass employee monitoring software. Appear active on Microsoft Teams, Slack, and Zoom while you take your well-deserved break. Outsmarting corporate surveillance with natural curves and human-like laziness. Read More - https://github.com/Deadpool2000/WASP

posts.name: FloPay
posts.tagline: Payment Orchestration That Keeps Revenue Flowing
posts.description: Your dedicated payments team in one SDK. FloPay maximizes authorization rates, recovers failed payments, and grows revenue from the customers you already have.

posts.name: Lunafic
posts.tagline: AI roleplay you build stories with over long memories
posts.description: Lunafic turns AI roleplay into a real story with layered long-turn memory. We solved long-standing problem of multi-character consistency. We embedded the chat into the editor-chat making possible to have Roleplay and Fanfiction at the same time. We also provided: - MC Mode, the AI is never allowed to write the character your played with - Professional narrative: Narrative depth, Characters that can fight back, Cinematic dialogue pacing, Persistent continuity, It waits for your turn

posts.name: Webruno
posts.tagline: Build your website, store & CRM with AI
posts.description: Webruno is an all-in-one platform for building and managing a business online. Create a professional website or online store without coding, then manage customers, orders, CRM, payments, SEO, SMS, and automation from one platform. Webruno combines website building, ecommerce, and business management in a single system. AI helps businesses create their website faster, while built-in CRM and automation tools help them manage and grow their business after launch.

posts.name: Duoveil
posts.tagline: An iPhone Duo-inspired lid animation for your MacBook
posts.description: Your MacBook deserves a closing scene. Inspired by the iPhone Duo animation, Duoveil makes your desktop fold and melt into a soft blur as you lower the lid. You might open it just to close it again.

posts.name: Deep Work Plan
posts.tagline: Models matter. Context matters more. Give your agent a plan.
posts.description: Deep Work Plan is spec-driven development where the repository itself becomes the harness: a durable plan, atomic tasks, acceptance criteria, and validation gates written into your repo — so coding agents run long-horizon work for hours without drift. Done is a contract, not a vibe: runs survive context resets, any agent resumes where the last left off. Works with any coding agent like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex: you plan, agents execute with precision. Any repo, no lock-in. Open Source, MIT.

posts.name: FeralUI Gradient Builder
posts.tagline: Create mesh, grainy and animated gradients. Export for free.
posts.description: Create mesh, grainy and animated gradients in your browser. Explore 20+ styles and palettes inspired by traditional Japanese colours. Adjust colours, texture and motion, then export PNG, SVG or MP4, with CSS and code options for supported styles. Free to use, with no signup or watermark.

posts.name: Projects at Cursor
posts.tagline: Direct thousands of agents through one coordinator
posts.description: Projects lets you take on larger bodies of work with a coordinator that maintains context, delegates to subagents, and runs recurring work.

posts.name: Video Analyzer

posts.description: Paste an Instagram reel or TikTok video. Our AI watches it frame by frame and tells you why it worked.

posts.name: VPNonly
posts.tagline: Choose which Mac apps use your VPN
posts.description: Choose which Mac apps use your VPN from the menu bar. Connect with NordVPN or import a WireGuard config. Keep other apps on their normal connection. $19 once for two Macs. Apple Silicon only; bring your own VPN.

posts.name: Burrak AI
posts.tagline: AI agents that keep working after you close the laptop
posts.description: Autonomous AI agents that take a goal, plan the steps and deliver finished work — research, reports, code fixes, follow-ups — then report back when done. Agents run on your machine or in the cloud, so work carries on after you close the laptop, and you can put them on a schedule. They connect to 66 services over the Model Context Protocol — GitHub, Google Workspace, Jira, Notion, Stripe — and remember context between sessions. Web, macOS, Windows, Android. Free tier; paid from $10/mo.

posts.name: CorosLink
posts.tagline: Manage, customize, and get more from your COROS watch
posts.description: CorosLink is an unofficial, open-source COROS watch companion for desktop. Sync music from Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, and Apple Music, download public Apple Podcasts episodes, install offline maps, build GPX routes, and review training analytics on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

posts.name: Stack Sniper
posts.tagline: 1-click tech stack detection and lead export for B2B sales.
posts.description: StackSniper is a lightweight Chrome extension that turns websites into actionable B2B lead lists. Instantly detect the underlying tech stack (Framer, Shopify, Webflow, React, etc.) of any website you visit, and export the domain data directly into a clean, CRM-ready CSV in one click. Stop manual prospecting and copy-pasting. Built for SDRs, marketing agencies, and founders who need to qualify leads faster.

posts.name: Conclave
posts.tagline: Make a decision. Challenge it. Refine it.
posts.description: Conclave is an open-source app for working through difficult decisions with AI agents. Describe your decision and constraints. Conclave runs parallel opportunity, evidence, and risk assessments, then synthesizes them into a recommendation you can challenge. In this video, I give Conclave a budget and deadline, challenge its recommendation, and ask what would change its mind in a mix of French and English. Open source. BYOK across major providers or try it free. Secured with HTTPS, HSTS, and CSP.

posts.name: Instant Photo Album
posts.tagline: Automatically organize iPhone photos into albums
posts.description: This app automatically gathers your iPhone photos into an Apple Photos album based on a time range you choose. Just enter a new album name or choose an existing album, then set a time window for a trip, birthday, or other event. Take photos with your usual iPhone Camera app, and Instant Photo Album automatically adds them to that album. You can also choose a past time range to automatically add photos taken during that time to an album, without selecting them one by one.

posts.name: OmniGIF
posts.tagline: gif, privacy, video, gif tools, gif generator, gif converter
posts.description: OmniGIF is a privacy-first GIF workspace built for creators, marketers, and developers. It runs entirely in your browser using client-side technology (WebAssembly & FFmpeg.wasm), so your files never leave your device. Key Features: Local Processing: Convert, edit, and create GIFs without any server upload. Much More Tools: Video ↔ GIF, format converters, frame editors, compressors, effects, and more. Privacy: No uploads. 100% local processing. Free: No sign-up, no watermarks, no limits.

posts.name: Guardbee.ai
posts.tagline: Find security & compliance risks with AI
posts.description: GuardBee helps businesses uncover website security, privacy, and compliance risks with AI-powered scans. Get clear, actionable insights without complex security tools or technical setup. Start scanning your website in minutes, identify potential issues, and improve your security posture with confidence.

posts.name: AegisNet

posts.description: AegisNet is an API-first security monitoring platform that detects suspicious authentication activity, scores user risk, generates security alerts, tracks sessions and devices, and helps administrators investigate potentially compromised accounts.

posts.description: Create your own LUTs from an image in seconds then download thecube file for use in your editing software.

posts.name: Zetken CI/CD Studio
posts.tagline: Build, run and debug CI/CD pipelines locally
posts.description: Zetken CI/CD Studio lets developers build, run and debug CI/CD pipelines locally on Windows, Linux and macOS before relying on remote CI. Create pipelines from scratch or migrate supported GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps YAML and Jenkins Declarative workflows. Get isolated stage/job/step logs, artifacts, cache, matrix jobs, needs, parameters, outputs and Docker build steps — with no remote runner required for local execution.

posts.name: YunCMS
posts.tagline: Self-hosted MySQL CMS with RBAC, AI, MCP and Docker
posts.description: YunCMS is an open-source, self-hosted MySQL CMS/backend for teams that want schema-driven content APIs without rebuilding auth, permissions and file handling. It combines a React Studio, REST API, field- and row-level RBAC, local/S3 files, extensions, and backup/update tooling. Run it with npm or the official multi-platform Docker Compose stack. Optional AI and MCP integrations operate under the signed-in user's existing permissions. The 0.1.x line is pre-stable.

posts.name: niceform.ai
posts.tagline: Make nice forms with AI — free, in seconds
posts.description: You describe it, you don't build it. Most form builders still start from a blank drag-and-drop canvas. A design chosen per form. The AI picks colours and fonts for each form instead of applying one template theme. It's the same thing the new hero shows off.

posts.name: Syngraphe
posts.tagline: Structured repo context behind AGENTS.md, for AI and humans.
posts.description: Syngraphe keeps repository context in a small, Git-native `.context/` directory of Markdown shared by both humans and coding agents, while AGENTS.md points agents to it. It separates stable project knowledge, current state, decisions and history. While the CLI adds initialization, integrity checks, context stats, document helpers, monorepo support and a GitHub Action. Open source, no database, cloud or lock-in. And it's repo/harness agnostic: the context still makes sense even without Syngraphe.

posts.name: Rebuno
posts.tagline: Open-source runtime for AI agents in production
posts.description: Rebuno is an open-source runtime for production AI agents. It records and checks every tool and model call, so agents resume where they stopped and only do what they're allowed to.

posts.name: Submora
posts.tagline: AI-powered backlink submission and link management
posts.description: Submora helps you find relevant backlink opportunities, generate platform-specific submission content with AI, follow step-by-step guides, autofill forms, and monitor every published link, visit, and signup. Stop manually tracking submissions across dozens of directories and manage your entire backlink workflow in one place.

posts.name: LUT Generator

It’s built on an open-source core, gives you 32 purpose-built tools, and lets you go from idea to ready-for-the-world faster. If Higgsfield and ElevenLabs grew into one open creative system for complete campaigns, that’s the direction we’re building with OpenCreative.

posts.name: Troupe: Plan & Split Trips
posts.tagline: Plan trips together. Split costs automatically. No chaos.

I built Troupe after one too many "who paid for the Airbnb?" arguments. One shared space: day-by-day itinerary, automatic cost splitting with the fewest transfers to settle up, shared packing list, and booking confirmations stored offline. Guests join via iCloud — no accounts, no signups. Free for up to 4 people.

posts.name: Just Schedule Me
posts.tagline: Create calendar events instantly
posts.description: Create calendar events instantly with Just Schedule Me. The fastest way to schedule meetings and events with natural language processing.

posts.name: Lidar

You read what they wrote and decide who is worth a reply, because Lidar never messages anyone on your behalf. One product is 14 euro a month, with a free trial.

Work with Apple Photos and folders in place. Editing and image analysis run on your Mac. Try the beta now via TestFlight. The Mac App Store release has been submitted to Apple for review.

posts.name: AgentDeck

posts.description: AgentDeck turns your desktop coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, pi) into remote mobile services you can reach from your phone. Built on Tauri 2, ACP protocol, and a durable private relay.

posts.name: Flashh AI
posts.tagline: Describe your idea, Build websites & web apps with AI
posts.description: You can describe your idea as a prompt and Flashh AI will do the rest. It will convert your idea into the real web application or website. If you are visionary and want to build something there is no other alternative than Flashh AI.

posts.name: inkwell - Write without distraction.
posts.tagline: #writing #notes
posts.description: A local-first markdown editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Your notes stay as plainmd files — private, portable, and completely under your control.

posts.name: PlotStudio
posts.tagline: Skip film school. Turn your idea into a finished AI film.
posts.description: PlotStudio takes you from a blank page to a finished film, no film degree required. One AI co-pilot writes your screenplay with real dramatic structure. Character likeness locks from a single photo, not the 20+ reference images most tools need. Footage generates in your chosen style, drawing on a library of over 2,000 structured cinematic techniques, so you never need to already know the language of film.

posts.name: KeyJoy
posts.tagline: Keyboard Mouse typing sounds
posts.description: Key Joy is a custom iOS keyboard with mechanical sound packs, beautiful themes, haptic feedback, multilingual typing, and a full emoji picker. Every keystroke can click, thock, or whisper - with haptics to match. SOUNDS THAT FEEL PHYSICAL Choose from clicky, tactile, linear, ASMR, and typewriter sound packs. Turn sounds and haptics on or off, adjust the volume, and hold a key for a satisfying press preview.

posts.name: Ramp4x4
posts.tagline: The Apple Watch coach for the Norwegian 4x4
posts.description: Ramp4x4 turns the proven Norwegian 4x4 protocol into one guided workout on iPhone and Apple Watch. V2 adds a clearer TRAIN flow, a complete 8-week plan, richer workout-quality analysis and Cardio Fitness trends, plus stronger phone–Watch reliability. Get live heart-rate targets, voice cues and haptics using Apple Watch, compatible Bluetooth HR monitors or Timer Only. Workout data stays on-device and in Apple Health.

posts.name: Safedrink
posts.tagline: Know when you'll be sober — a BAC timer tuned to your body
posts.description: Log each drink and Safedrink estimates your BAC and counts down to zero. Personalized with Watson's body-water formula, keeps ticking in your notification shade, no account, data stays on device. Free, open-source core. Reference only — never drive on it.

posts.name: OneDock
posts.tagline: Tab Manager, Chrome extendsion
posts.description: OneDock is built for people who spend a large part of their day in a browser — developers, researchers, students, creators, and anyone who regularly ends up with 30, 50, or 100+ tabs open. It helps you see your entire browser, find the page you need, clean up without fear, and keep Chrome running light — without a permanent sidebar.

posts.name: Archive Builder
posts.tagline: Archive Builder is a specialized desktop app for eng & softw
posts.description: Archive Builder is a specialized desktop application designed for engineering and software teams to quickly filter, organize, and package complex project directories into clean, standardized client deliverables. Instead of manually sorting through thousands of working files, teams can set metadata (like package types and revision codes), selectively filter files by extension or folder, and build secure zip archives in a few clicks.

posts.name: MyItihas
posts.tagline: Sign Your Moments
posts.description: MyItihas is a private, real-time social and messaging platform: Moments, direct chats, community circles, and Vibe AI, an AI companion that now drafts posts, finds people, and gets things done. Free across 14 languages.

posts.name: PDF Annotator
posts.tagline: RENiX PDF Annotator is a purpose‑built Windows desktop app
posts.description: RENiX PDF Annotator is a purpose‑built Windows desktop application for reviewing and marking up engineering drawings, shop drawings, and technical PDFs. Every markup is true vector — crisp at any zoom — and saved back into a standard PDF that opens anywhere, while remaining fully re‑editable in RENiX. It runs entirely on your PC; no account, no cloud, no internet required.

posts.name: PostOtter
posts.tagline: Automated Social Media Manager for Small Businesses
posts.description: PostOtter is an AI social media manager for small business. It writes the captions, picks the hashtags, makes the images and video, schedules the week, and posts to Instagram, TikTok & X every day. First week free.

posts.name: Offly
posts.tagline: Play audio and video offline. Comes with Siri and CarPlay
posts.description: Play the music and videos you own on iPhone and iPad. Offly brings together CarPlay, crossfade, interactive widgets, Wi-Fi file transfers and seven player Looks. All features are free. Optional one-time purchases and monthly or yearly subscriptions support development. No streaming account is needed.

posts.name: OK Solitaire
posts.tagline: A mobile reimagining of classic Klondike solitaire
posts.description: Klondike, rebuilt from scratch in Swift/SpriteKit with obsessive attention to touch. Cards are snappy and physical: drag a row, scrub to cut a stack, flick to the foundation, haptics on every move. It's the same game you already know, with the input model it never had. Daily challenge – Everyone gets the same deal, compete on a Game Center leaderboard, keep a streak. Insight mode – Tells you if your current board is still winnable, and rewinds you to the last move where it was.

posts.name: SiteDuel
posts.tagline: Launch your product, compete, and get discovered.
posts.description: SiteDuel is a product discovery platform where founders can launch their products, compete in 24-hour head-to-head duels, and receive genuine community feedback. Users can discover new products, vote for their favorites, join discussions, and explore the leaderboard. Winners gain additional exposure through badges and showcase placements, helping promising products get noticed.

posts.name: RenameClick
posts.tagline: Rename audio and automate filing with local AI
posts.description: RenameClick now goes beyond batch renaming on Mac and Windows: name recordings from speech, connect watched folders into Auto Flow workflows, and sort files into existing folders or nested paths built from dates and EXIF. AI Search finds images and documents by content. With Local AI installed and selected, processing stays on your device. Preview and edit suggestions before applying, or enable Auto Apply per workflow. Free: unlimited analysis and 30 successful renames/moves per month.

posts.name: Plancove
posts.tagline: Turn school messages into a shared family plan
posts.description: Plancove turns school emails, screenshots and PDFs into dates, deadlines and prep for each child. Review the details, share the plan with caregivers, and know what to bring, pay or sign. For iPhone. Includes a 14-day free trial.

posts.name: SpacerrApps
posts.tagline: Launch your app and get a real write-up, free
posts.description: A free directory of independent apps. List yours, we write the news about it, and both stay online with a link back to your site. No card, no queue, no invitation.

posts.name: ARIA
posts.tagline: Structural intelligence for unfamiliar codebases
posts.description: ARIA helps developers understand unfamiliar codebases before making changes. It combines AST-based code analysis, dependency and call graphs, semantic search, API intelligence, and repository-aware AI to turn complex repositories into structured, searchable engineering knowledge.

posts.name: MAVO 3D - Major optimization update
posts.tagline: Smarter optimization for more accurate 3D point clouds
posts.description: MAVO v2.0 introduces a redesigned optimization pipeline for more accurate and reliable 3D point clouds for professional 3D building documentation. It improves drift detection and correction, handles rotational movement more robustly, and delivers more stable processing for large and complex indoor scans. The scanning workflow stays the same. Enable RAW data and perform loop closures. Existing projects can be optimized again using the original raw data.

posts.name: Deck Divider
posts.tagline: Track your Pokémon cards, slabs, and decks in one place
posts.description: DECK/divider is a brand new way to keep track of your Pokémon card collection. Add the cards you own, log your graded slabs from PSA, BGS, or CGC, and build decks that follow the actual tournament rules. Prices update on their own using real market data, in whatever currency you use. There are no ads and no clutter, just your cards in one place. It covers every set, from the original Base Set all the way up to the newest release.

posts.name: OhKept
posts.tagline: Everything you'd forget. Kept.
posts.description: Never lose a warranty, receipt, or forget a subscription renewal again. OhKept is your private, encrypted life vault for appliance warranties, receipts, vehicle maintenance logs, health records, subscriptions, and family sharing with sandboxed Google Drive sync.
